newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds prices higher, trade at standstill.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds prices higher, trade at standstill.

text.p: High protein soymeal prices were around four to five stg a tonne higher on the UK meals and feeds market on Wednesday following gains in Chicago overnight.
However, buyers stayed away following the USDA's lastest crop report which was seen as bearish and is expected to hit Chicago futures prices.
"I have not heard of a single trade, every one seems to be waiting to see what happens in Chicago," said a trader.
